_doc: Ledger 0054 Phase 2 (Mission Gorge Speedway), step 2: the HELD race declaration of the north loop, on Lake Murray v4's committed intermediates (ledger 0065: v4 is the line). NOT in track.config.json and NOT enabled: plan_north.py beside this file merges it into a SCRATCH copy of the config and runs the race tools' plan modes (race_lap.stitch, layout_dummies, barrier_bands with the planned no_route). Everything here is keyed on the LAP's own vertices (data/lap.north.json, 2,936 unique vertices, 8,732.7 m with the declared J2-J4 curves): no mainline vertex number, no race.chicanes (College's crossover chicane is the mainline's, ledger 0055). Corridor limits are the existing Speedway's, unchanged (copied from race.corridor by plan_north.py except whole / boxes / closure_runs / pin_rate, which are the lap's own); clear_width_source none (the lap has no Alvarado to re-measure on). Activating it means copying lap + layouts into track.config.json AFTER the PC's authoring and built gates (ledger 0054 'Phase 2 - step 1..4').
built_on: Lake Murray v4 0.20.0 intermediates (claude/lm-v4-line): data/centerline.local.json, connectors.local.json, mouths.json, median_bands.json, pads.plan.json

north._roads_doc: street per vertex (barrier_bands._streets): v0 then each detected corner apex in order (J2 v320, J3 v707, J4 v1458, J5 v2130, J1 v2932), six spans: Waring from v0, Princess View, Mission Gorge, Jackson, Navajo, and the J1 turn from v2932 back to v0 (named apart: object names are per street)
north._island_offsets_doc: scripts/geometry/race_lap.py (ledger 0054 Phase 2, 2026-11-04): every north piece's raised median where it really stands. median_bands connector_islands carry each median's own centre line (offset_aware), one point per connector vertex; the default 1.0 m snap dropped every point more than 1 m off the connector line, which cut the medians into fragments (Waring v188-264, Mission Gorge v14-70 among others) and moved their ends (Waring's start 30 m after J1 at v11 was really v8, 1.3 m right; its tail before J2 at v315, 1.7 m left, 2.0 m wide). Each vertex takes its nearest island point within 2.5 m (the points stand ~3 m apart along the road) and that point's lateral offset; race_corridor puts the closure on the offset island's race face. Since step 2e (2026-11-04) an offset_aware island (one point per connector vertex) is read by index, however far its point stands off the line (Jackson's nose 2.6-3.6 m at lap v1478-1489); snap_m is the fallback for any other island
north._joins_doc: J2, J3, J4: cubic curves off the roads' own approach tangents (832facf), a reference line through each pad, never an AI spline and never road geometry. J5 (11.6 m) and J1 (14.6 m) stay straight joins: both lie inside the mainline's own junction box (Navajo/Jackson, College/Navajo), whose pavement is built
north._junction_pads_doc: the three pads the lap drives through; their six stub arms (Mound Ave, Waring SW = the future Zion link, Mission Gorge W = the future Zion link, the quarry drive, Mission Gorge E, the MTRP entrance) become pad_arm mouths probed 10 m into the stub, before the Free Roam end barrier

corridor._whole_doc: Navajo westbound, mainline v2022..v1832 (undivided, 17.0 m): the whole street for the grid and the start / finish, 190 m

boxes._corner: J2 Waring / Princess View / Mound (pad J2), R 18.9 m, D -82.0 (refit join); i = PC - 1 (not PC-2): Waring's median tail stands at v315, the box starts beside it
J3 Princess View / Mission Gorge (pad J3), R 22.6 m, D -79.4 (refit join); PC-2 .. PT+2

J4 Mission Gorge / Jackson north (pad J4), R 16.4 m, D -69.0 (refit join); from v1452 (Mission Gorge's median runs to v1451 beside the box edge) to PT+3; the pad's Mission Gorge east arm (lap v1468) stands inside the box, sealed by the far strip
J5 Jackson / Navajo (mainline v2317 box), R 9.1 m, D -90.1
J1 Navajo / College / Waring (mainline v1517 box), R 8.3 m, D -78.3; j PT+4 (the box ends past the seam)

corridor._boxes_doc: PC-2 .. PT+2 of the five corners barrier_bands detects on the lap (place_signs' detector, min turn 45 deg), the mainline's rule, re-declared on the refit J2-J4 joins (2026-11-04); exactly five, one per junction. J2 starts at PC (v316): the real median tail stands at v315
corridor._pin_rate_doc: none declared. Tried 695: 5.0 / 1470: 4.5 (2026-11-03): the solver still misses the declared rate by the same share. The cause (2026-11-04) was the smoothing, not the rate: see smooth_window

noses.why: Waring's raised median starts 16 m after the J1 box (v8, 1.5 m wide, 1.3 m right of the line: race.laps.north.island_offsets). The closure ends at the nose (pin v7) and a K-rail crosses the far carriageway there: your own side of the road (Kevin's call, ledger 0054)

Waring's median runs to its tail at v315 (2.0 m wide, 1.7 m left of the line), beside the J2 box: the closure ends at the box edge on the tail's race face (pin v316) with a K-rail across the far carriageway
Mission Gorge's median starts 18 m after the J3 box (v718, 0.6 m wide at its nose, 0.6 m right of the line): the closure ends at the nose (pin v717) with a K-rail across the far carriageway
Mission Gorge's median runs to v1451, beside the J4 box: the closure ends at the box edge on its race face (pin v1452) with a K-rail across the far carriageway

Jackson's median starts 15 m after the J4 box (v1478, a 1.5 m nose 3.6 m right of the line: its points stand past any snap, so the lap takes them by index since step 2e; the 0.20.2 run's north_cw drove onto its curb at v1478-1479). The closure ends at the nose (pin v1477) with a K-rail across the far carriageway

corridor._noses_doc: tools/barrier_bands.py race.corridor.noses (ledger 0054 Phase 2): each closure-run end (a box edge) that ends at a median nose instead of the far curb strip; the pin is the vertex beside the nose, on the island's race face, and the K-rail runs from the closure's race face to the far curb strip, in that layout's closure kn5
corridor._smooth_window_doc: the closure's smoothing Gaussian over +-3 sigma of STATION with trapezoid weights (tools/race_corridor.py). The lap mixes 2 m curved joins with 3 m streets; the default +-4-vertex window is lopsided where they meet and pulled the closure off its own pin-zone envelope at v683-685 (1:5.49 of 1:6) and v1477-1479 (1:4.62 of 1:5.01). Not a threshold: the rates and limits are unchanged

trims.why: Pulled back by the kerb's own geometry (ledger 0054 Phase 2 step 2d; plan_north.py checks every north kerb with race_furniture.kerb_column_margin and names this run, race_furniture.kerb_standing_run): at the refit J4 apex the lap's radius (R 15.4 m at v1463) barely clears w/2 (14.4 m), so the inside kerb's outer column swings round about 1.8 m from the corner's centre and advances only 2-9 mm per 0.3 m station over v1463-v1464 (11 spans under the author's 0.01 m record resolution, 0.0141 m; the PC's 0.20.2 run read 2 of them inside-out, verify_race I). The longest station run that stands ends 0.3 m before v1463 (12.6 m); rounded in to its vertices it is v1457-v1462 (11.2 m of the detected 26.9 m, the turn-in up to the apex), column margin 0.0147 m. The exit side v1465-v1469 stands too, but a declared kerb is one run. J4's radius floor is not raised: the strips already stand 0.025 m inside the pad there

Held until the PC authors the J5 connection (Phase 2 step 1): the lap's J5 corner is an 11.6 m straight join inside the mainline's Navajo/Jackson box, R 9.1 m; its inside kerb folds on itself (race_furniture: no trim resolves it) and the mainline drops its own inside kerb here for the ribbon fold (race.kerbs.trims apex 2319). Re-declared once the corner surface is authored and measured on the built road

Held until the PC authors the J1 connection (Phase 2 step 1, coordinated with ledger 0055): the lap's J1 corner is a 14.6 m straight join inside the mainline's College/Navajo box, R 8.3 m, the same fold class; the mainline drops its own inside kerb here (apex 1514). Re-declared once the corner surface is authored and measured
